mechanism: Always-in-market net: OUT>0.5 Buy else Sell. On OUT sign flip or ±TP/SL hit, set teacher = sigmoid(0.1·TradePos·ProfitPos) from closed-trade P&L in points; backprop from the entry pattern. Symmetric TP=SL recommended to avoid trend bias. MPS (Profit-Maximizing System) trains direction alerts to maximize correctly predicted trades rather than price MSE.
data_needed: Chronological input patterns + bar OHLC; TP/SL in points; network outputs; TradePos and ProfitPos per closed leg.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: FX bars with TP=SL=50 pts demo; method TF-agnostic
why_new_for_mis: Replaces fixed price-target teachers with online P&L-shaped teachers—MIS can adapt sequence sensors to realized trade utility, not bar forecast error.
quote: this method can be called dynamic. The method used is known as MPS - Profit-Maximizing System.

mechanism: After training, build table Out|ProfitPos per bar; summarize ProfitPos by Out bins; pick band [MLo,MHi] (or margin M around 0.5) with best profit and trade only when Out>0.5+M (buy) or Out<0.5−M (sell), sifting mid-band vectors. Turns continuous net output into an empirically gated entry sensor.
data_needed: Per-bar network Out and realized ProfitPos under a chosen exit rule (sign flip or stops); histogram/summary of ProfitPos vs Out.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same FX training set as MPS section; NeuroInd paints colored Out ranges

mechanism: SmoothXSeries(number, SmoothMode, din, MaxBar, limit, Phase, Length, Series, bar, reset) selects among JJMA, JurX, ParMA, LRMA, T3, SMA, EMA, SSMA, LWMA via SmoothMode 0–8. PriceSeries feeds CLOSE…Heiken Ashi / TRENDFOLLOW prices. One call site becomes a plug-in smoother bank for any indicator/EA—optimize Length/Phase with algorithm identity as a discrete choice (prefer grid over genetic for SmoothMode).

mechanism: Cascade two SmoothXSeries calls (X2MA): first Length1/Mode1 on price, second Length2/Mode2 (often JMA Mode2=0, Length2∈{3,5,7,9,11}) on the result to cut false flips at cost of lag. Then X2DigMa: Norma=Step*Point; x2ma=NormalizeDouble(x2ma/Norma,0)*Norma so the moving becomes a discrete price-grid state. EA externals expose both stages for market-specific fitting.
data_needed: OHLC/custom price; Smooth_Mode1/2, Length1/2, Phase1/2, Step in points; IndicatorCounted incremental loop.

mechanism: NeuroMACD: inputs = lagged triples (10×MACD main, signal, main−signal) on M5; separate long/short FANN stacks (4 layers: AnnInputs→AnnInputs→AnnInputs/2+1→1, SIGMOID_SYMMETRIC_STEPWISE). On closed ticket, train_output=+1/−1 from OrderProfit and f2M_train on remembered entry InputVector. With NeuroFilter, open only if ensemble mean ann_wise_* > Delta. Online incremental learning turns MACD crosses into filtered entries.
data_needed: iMACD Fast/Slow/Signal series; AnnInputs (÷3); AnnsNumber; saved .net files under C:\ANN\; closed-order profit sign; Delta threshold.
